content: Mining progression depends on Heart of the Mountain progression, powder, gear, and access to mining areas. Players should generally improve their setup before expecting high mining profits.
Heart of the Mountain perks are important for mining progression. Players should prioritize useful mining perks and powder collection before focusing on maximum gemstone profits.
Mining gear upgrades should match the player's current stage. Expensive mining setups are inefficient if the player lacks required HotM progression, powder, or knowledge of mining routes.
